name: BSP_Bot_SubControllerForCommand
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_attack_commands; docs/ATTACK_COMMANDS.md and reports/attack_commands.json. void* __thiscall(ECX = bot)(CommandClass* klass). Maps a class to a fixed offset inside the bot: stop +BD8h, cruise +BC8h, follow +BE4h, land +C38h, moveto +C5Ch, moveonpath +C64h, and artillery with attackmove sharing +C70h, or +217Ch/+2254h when bot+B0Ch is non-zero (chosen by 00779AA0). No other class has a slot. That artillery and attackmove share one is the AI-side confirmation of 00817229's rewrite.

name: BSP_ShipAi_SyncStateToCurrentCommand
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc_cruise_command, read-only analysis. __fastcall(ai), RET 0, body 009F3DD0-... Takes the unit's weapon director through [ai+0B00h]->vtable[114h], asks 0071BE40 for its current command, substitutes the cruise object 00E08F70 when the unit's player-controlled byte +184h is set, compares it with the current state's own command ([ai+2264h]->vtable[24h]) and switches state through 009F3D00 when they differ. docs/CRUISE_COMMAND.md

name: BSP_UnitBot_RequestLoadLevels
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet unit_command_producers, read-only analysis. void __thiscall(this, float dt), RET 4 (009F4D04), body 009F3F80-009F4D06, caller 009F4DA0, unit at this+3FCh. Raises the unit's two load latches six times: 009F438C and 009F4AB4 to computed levels, 009F4606 and 009F462A to 1.5f (00CE380C), 009F4912 when +1034h is below 1.5 (00CE3D78) and 009F4A51 when +102Ch is below 0.5 (00D7A280) to 0.5f (00CE3800). Each site is the inlined form of 009D4FB0/009D4FE0, a per-frame maximum latch; 009F45F8..009F4606 was confirmed against the listing. This resolves the open producer of unit+102Ch and +1034h that docs/UNIT_FORCE_COMMANDS.md recorded as reader-only. See docs/UNIT_COMMAND_PRODUCERS.md.

name: BSP_Command_IsOrdnanceAttackClass
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_attack_commands; docs/ATTACK_COMMANDS.md and reports/attack_commands.json. int __cdecl(CommandClass* klass). Seven compares and nothing else: levelbomb, dropkamikaze, divebomb, torpedo, kamikaze, rocket, depthcharge. They are exactly the category-2 classes and exactly 007EEC50's ordnance pass.

name: BSP_Bot_RevalidateCurrentCommand
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Packet cc2_attack_commands; docs/ATTACK_COMMANDS.md and reports/attack_commands.json. void __fastcall(ECX = bot). Re-tests the running command each tick. The general rule at 009F8231 is the class category: 1 or 2 needs a live target and must still pass 007EE8F0, otherwise the command goes to LAB_009F8412. The seven ordnance classes take a faster path to the same test at 009F823C; land is abandoned by setting bot+3Ch; dogfight breaks off when the target's own command is retreat. Partial: LAB_009F8412 and the 009F8460 tail were not read.

name: BSP_Ai_AttackClassWeightSlot
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. name: BSP_Ai_EffectiveGameModeIndex
evidence: Hypothesis, not a recovered symbol. Replaces the earlier name BSP_Ai_CurrentPartySlot, which was wrong: this answers a game-mode index, not a party slot. It calls BSP_Game_GetEffectiveGameMode (004BCA50) at 009FFC8D and dispatches on it through the jump table at 009FFCFC, returning the literals 3, 4, 5 and 6 for four arms and, on the island-capture arm at 009FFC9E, a difficulty from [game+EAX*4+18CCh]+2Ch minus 3 clamped into 0..2. 00A371A0 multiplies the result by 23Ch to index the AI mode tuning array whose seven sub-tables 00A335D0 fills in exactly this order: IslandCaptureParams_Rookie, _Regular, _Veteran, DuelParams, EscortParams, SiegeParams, CompetitiveParams. No party array is touched anywhere in the body. docs/AI_GLOBALS_AND_TARGET_WEIGHTS.md.
